items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: my idea was to have this small band with arrangements like Trent's, on the idea of entertainment, singing, playing and like Jimmy Lunceford, that's what I wanted.

ctx.x: You were playing basically--were you playing the same style that you had when you started making the records on Decca? Did your style evolve?

I think I was playing the same thing that we made on records, because my idea was to have this small band with arrangements like Trent's, on the idea of entertainment, singing, playing and like Jimmy Lunceford, that's what I wanted.
If you'd a little more luck, you could have gotten what Louis Jordan did.
